import json, subprocess, sys

def run(case):
    raw = json.dumps({'cases': [case]}).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/solver.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:400]
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]

case = {'primitive': 'allgather', 'mode': 2, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1, 'capacity': 1,
        'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': r, 'p': 0} for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'results'},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 1}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'a1'},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 1, 'upto': 2}, {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 2, 'upto': 3},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 3, 'upto': 3}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'a4'},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 2}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'a5'},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 3}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'a6'},
                   {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 1, 'upto': 3}, {'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'done'}]}
out = run(case)
for s in out['snapshots']:
    st = s['state']
    print('%-8s b=%d occ=%d S=%s acked=%s U=%s tx_data=%d tx_ack=%d' %
          (s['tag'], st[0], st[1], st[6:10], st[10:14], st[14:18], st[20], st[21]))
exp = {'results': (0, [3, 3, 3, 3], [0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0], 12, 0),
       'a1': (0, [3, 3, 3, 3], [1, 0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0], 12, 0),

       'a5': (0, [3, 3, 3, 3], [2, 2, 3, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0], 12, 3),
       'a6': (0, [3, 3, 3, 3], [3, 2, 3, 3], [1, 1, 1, 1], 12, 4),
       'done': (1, [3, 3, 3, 3], [3, 3, 3, 3], [1, 1, 1, 1], 12, 5)}
